handbookNote: New Jersey MVC Driver Manual (2025 edition), fetched directly from the official njmvc.gov site at https://www.nj.gov/mvc/pdf/license/drivermanual.pdf (linked from the official manuals page https://www.nj.gov/mvc/about/manuals.htm) and archived to temp/handbooks/nj/driver.txt. Real exam mechanics CONFIRMED directly from the manual's own 'Driver Testing' chapter: the knowledge test consists of 50 scored questions plus one non-scored organ-donation survey question; the passing score is 80 percent, i.e. 40 of 50 correct. The manual does not state a time limit for the knowledge test, and the MVC's separate knowledgetest.htm page also does not mention one -- so this track is treated as untimed/self-paced per the official source, not a guess. Content-depth rationale: this is a genuinely long, detailed 2025 manual (224 pages, ~9,000 extracted lines covering license types and GDL, driver testing, driver responsibility, safe-driving rules, defensive driving, drinking/drugs/health, driver privilege and penalties incl. a full moving-violation point chart and DUI/BAC penalty tables, sharing the road, vehicle information, plus an illustrated Driver Safety appendix with a sign shape/color/message reference table) -- comfortably supporting the 250-300 question target across 10 topic buckets (licensing/GDL, driver testing, driver responsibility, traffic laws, defensive driving, DUI/alcohol/health, penalties/points, sharing the road, vehicle equipment, signs/signals/markings) with no invented facts; the motorcycle-endorsement chapter and MVC-locations appendix were deliberately excluded as out of scope for the basic Class D knowledge test.
